Use this interactive problem engine to practice circuit analysis across **DC Networks (Mesh, Nodal & Dependent Sources)**, **Thévenin & Norton Equivalents**, **AC Sinusoidal Steady-State (Phasors)**, **First-Order RC & RL Transients**, **Second-Order RLC Transients**, and **Operational Amplifiers**. Click **New Circuit Topology** within any category to cycle through different circuit schematics, complete with step-by-step mathematical derivations, **LTspice netlists**, and **Overleaf LaTeX (`circuitikz`)** code.
